proposal.summary: Integer overflow in Exynos Mobile Processor 980 and 2100 can corrupt a buffer index and prevent execution of requested services when triggered by a crafted application.
proposal.cwe_quote: An integer overflow at a buffer index

AV.quote: prevent the execution of requested services via a crafted application

A.quote: prevent the execution of requested services

proposal.recommended_next_step: Request the original report or vendor advisory for reproduction details, affected firmware/build IDs, and a full technical description to confirm impact and produce a CVE and mitigation guidance.

evidence_quotes.quote: An issue was discovered in Exynos Mobile Processor 980 and 2100.
An integer overflow at a buffer index
can prevent the execution of requested services via a crafted application.
